reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis overstates the role of mixing entropy in guaranteeing a single-phase solid solution for noble metal HEA nanoparticles, ignoring the well-known immiscibility and positive mixing enthalpies of several noble metal pairs (e.g., Au-Pt, Au-Ru) that can drive phase segregation even at equiatomic compositions.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with a well-defined falsification criterion based on comparing structural homogeneity and catalytic performance between equiatomic and non-equiatomic samples.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a central question in the field but is built on a potentially flawed premise; testing it would still provide valuable data, though a more nuanced hypothesis would be more useful.
